name: all_stock_premium_exchange_ratio_fee_shares_signed_move
question_template: All-stock deal. Target's unaffected price is {TGT_PX} USD; the offer is a {PREM} percent premium. Acquirer trades at {ACQ_PX} USD pre-announcement. Target has {TGT_SH} million shares, Acquirer {ACQ_SH} million. The exchange ratio is fixed as offer price divided by Acquirer's pre-announcement price and is never adjusted. Acquirer's price then moves {MOVE} percent by closing (negative is a fall). Advisory fees of {FEE} percent of total offer value (offer price times Target shares) are paid in new Acquirer shares issued to advisors at the closing price. Realized gain per Target share is closing value received minus unaffected price, as a signed percent of unaffected price. Report Target holders' percent ownership of combined shares: old Acquirer shares plus shares issued to Target holders plus fee shares.

slots.description: Acquirer shares per Target share from offer price and pre-announcement price
Total Acquirer shares issued to Target holders
Signed realized gain per Target share versus unaffected price, in percent
Acquirer shares issued to advisors at the closing price

program:
def solve():
    tgt_px = Q(P["TGT_PX"])
    prem = Q(P["PREM"]) / 100
    acq_px = Q(P["ACQ_PX"])
    tgt_sh = Q(P["TGT_SH"]) * 1000000
    acq_sh = Q(P["ACQ_SH"]) * 1000000
    move = Q(P["MOVE"]) / 100
    fee = Q(P["FEE"]) / 100
    offer = tgt_px * (1 + prem)
    ratio = offer / acq_px
    new_sh = ratio * tgt_sh
    close_px = acq_px * (1 + move)
    if close_px <= 0:
        raise ValueError("closing price must be positive")
    fee_val = fee * offer * tgt_sh
    fee_sh = fee_val / close_px
    gain_pct = (ratio * close_px - tgt_px) / tgt_px * 100
    own_pct = new_sh / (acq_sh + new_sh + fee_sh) * 100
    return {
        "final": own_pct,
        "exchange_ratio": ratio,
        "target_holder_shares": new_sh,
        "realized_gain_pct": gain_pct,
        "fee_shares": fee_sh
    }
